newsitem.title: USA: Dow hits new intraday high on calm inflation data.
newsitem.headline: Dow hits new intraday high on calm inflation data.

text.p: U.S. stocks roared higher at the open Friday, with the Dow climbing above the 5.800 level for the first time after economic data raised hopes the Fed would not tighten rates at its upcoming September 24 meeting.
The Dow industrials rose 34 to 5,806. while the NASDAQ Index was up 13 at 1,179 and the S&P Index five at 676.
The long bond was up 41/32 to yield 6.97 percent.
